blocks.text: Day 7 · Half-day tour (shared) of Salvador’s essential sights, tracing the development of one of Brazil’s largest cities from its simple beginnings. Your guide takes you to the mouth of the immense bay, then along elegant tree-lined avenues and bustling streets to the Pelourinho, a UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of the largest ensembles of colonial architecture in South America. From the Municipal Square, by the towering Lacerda Elevator overlooking the bay and the lower city, stroll through narrow streets lined with pastel-coloured buildings, and visit the Church of São Francisco, with its exuberant gilded Baroque interior, and the Pelourinho square, the heart of the old town.
